description: This file defines the EncounterSearchCriteriaBuilder class, a builder for constructing EncounterSearchCriteria objects with various search parameters such as patient, location, date ranges, encounter types, providers, visit types, visits, and whether to include voided encounters. It facilitates a fluent API for assembling complex search criteria in the OpenMRS core project.

classes.name: EncounterSearchCriteriaBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating instances of EncounterSearchCriteria with a flexible set of search parameters.

methods.name: setPatient
methods.description: Sets the patient for search criteria.

methods.name: setLocation
methods.description: Sets the location for search criteria.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for encounter search range.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for encounter search range.

methods.name: setDateChanged
methods.description: Sets the minimum date the encounter was changed.

methods.name: setEnteredViaForms
methods.description: Sets the collection of forms that entered the encounter.

methods.name: setEncounterTypes
methods.description: Sets the collection of encounter types.

methods.name: setVisitTypes
methods.description: Sets the collection of visit types.

methods.name: setIncludeVoided
methods.description: Specifies whether to include voided encounters.

methods.name: createEncounterSearchCriteria
methods.description: Builds and returns a new EncounterSearchCriteria object with the specified parameters.
